boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Texas A&M University-College Station
boards.description: Ten currently documented College Station food stops with late service, spanning the University Drive area and nearby campus corridors.

cards.title: Fuego Tortilla Grill
cards.subtitle: 108 Poplar St, College Station
cards.notes: Use the Poplar Street location when you need a late food stop; confirm the day before going, since Monday is listed as closed.
cards.short_summary: A College Station taco-and-burrito stop with documented midnight or 24-hour availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Fuego Tortilla Grill at 108 Poplar Street as open Tuesday until midnight and Wednesday through Sunday for 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Fuego Tortilla Grill | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday 6 AM–12 AM; Wednesday–Sunday open 24 hours; Monday closed.

cards.title: Denny's on Texas Avenue
cards.subtitle: 607 Texas Ave, College Station
cards.notes: Choose this all-day breakfast stop for a sit-down late meal; the official listing shows continuous daily operation with ordering available.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner option on Texas Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists the College Station restaurant at 607 Texas Avenue as open 12 AM–11:58 PM every day.
cards.source_title: Denny's at 607 Texas Avenue, College Station
cards.access_notes: Official store hours list 12 AM–11:58 PM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Subway on West University
cards.subtitle: 601 W University Dr, Suite 103, College Station
cards.notes: Use the West University location for a late sandwich pickup; its official location page lists the same 1 AM close every day.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich counter with nightly hours extending to 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official page lists its 601 W University Drive restaurant open 10 AM–1 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Subway at 601 W University Dr, College Station
cards.access_notes: Official store hours: 10 AM–1 AM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on University Drive
cards.subtitle: 731 University Dr, College Station
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service if you arrive after midnight; the location’s dine-in and drive-thru hours are listed separately.
cards.short_summary: A University Drive drive-thru open to 2 AM most nights and 3 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 731 University Drive until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 731 University Dr, College Station
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday; 9 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday. Check dine-in hours separately.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Harvey Road
cards.subtitle: 310 N Harvey Rd, College Station
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest window at this location; its official listing separates drive-thru service from dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A North Harvey Road taco stop with drive-thru service after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 310 N Harvey Road until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 310 N Harvey Road, College Station
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 9 AM–2 AM Sunday–Thursday; 9 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Whataburger at Dominik and Texas
cards.subtitle: 105 Dominik Dr, College Station
cards.notes: Keep this campus-area Whataburger in reserve for an overnight food run; the company’s College Station locator marks it open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger at the Dominik Drive and Texas Avenue area.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger's official College Station locator lists the 105 Dominik Drive location as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Whataburger Locations in College Station, Texas
cards.access_notes: Official location locator marks this restaurant open 24 hours; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Whataburger on Wellborn Road
cards.subtitle: 1451 Wellborn Rd, College Station
cards.notes: Use this Wellborn Road location for an overnight drive-thru run; the official page identifies the drive-thru as available around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger near Wellborn Road and Southwest Parkway.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger's official page states that the 1451 Wellborn Road location's drive-thru remains available 24/7.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 1451 Wellborn Rd, College Station
cards.access_notes: Official page states the drive-thru is available 24/7; curbside hours vary by day.

cards.title: Domino's on University Drive
cards.subtitle: 409 A University Dr, College Station
cards.notes: Order ahead for carryout or delivery from this University Drive store; its official location page displays a 2 AM close for the current day.
cards.short_summary: A University Drive pizza location with a documented 2 AM late close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page for 409 A University Drive displays the College Station store as open until 2 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 409 A University Dr, College Station
cards.access_notes: Official page displayed “Open Today Until 2:00 AM” when fetched; check the location page for day-specific changes.

cards.title: Tiff's Treats on University Drive
cards.subtitle: 1099 University Dr, #113, College Station
cards.notes: Place an order before heading over for cookies; the company lists this University Drive retail location as closing at midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A cookie shop with midnight hours on University Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Tiff's Treats lists its College Station retail location at 1099 University Drive open until 12 AM on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: Tiff's Treats — University Drive, College Station
cards.access_notes: Official store hours: Monday–Friday 9 AM–12 AM; Saturday–Sunday 10 AM–12 AM.

cards.title: McDonald's on Rock Prairie Road
cards.subtitle: 1750 Rock Prairie Rd, College Station
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when the lobby has closed; the official restaurant page lists drive-thru service at this location as open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A Rock Prairie Road fast-food stop with 24-hour drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official restaurant page lists the drive-thru at 1750 Rock Prairie Road as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 1750 Rock Prairie Rd, College Station
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed as open 24 hours daily; lobby hours are shorter and vary by day.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named places in Texas A&M’s public Gardens where you can meet, walk, look closely, or take a break without admission.

cards.title: Pause by the Rose Bed
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Meet at the bench beside the rose bed, then take a slow lap through the surrounding teaching gardens before heading to your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A planted rose bed with a bench in the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Rose Bed is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Walk the Mexican Heritage Garden
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Use the open plaza and water-feature setting as a calm meetup point, then continue through nearby themed garden paths together.
cards.short_summary: A named garden with an open plaza, water feature, and ornamental plants.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Mexican Heritage Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Trace the Vineyard Rows
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Take a short walk alongside the vineyard and compare the three grape varieties described on the garden’s interpretive material.
cards.short_summary: An educational vineyard growing three varieties of grapes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Leach Wine Grape Vineyard is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Look for Pollinators
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Walk both planted sections slowly and look for butterflies and bees using the nectar and pollen plants, without disturbing them.
cards.short_summary: A two-part planted habitat designed to support pollinators.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Butterfly and Bee Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Meet Under the Grand Arbor
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Use the shaded arbor as a clear rendezvous point, then choose a garden path to explore while keeping the group at an easy pace.
cards.short_summary: A metal arbor between the Butterfly and Bee and Texas Superstar gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Bobbitt Family Grand Arbor is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Compare Texas Superstar Plants
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Circle the colorful plantings and trade observations about foliage, flowers, and trees identified by Texas A&M AgriLife as reliable in Texas.
cards.short_summary: A display garden of Texas A&M AgriLife-identified Texas Superstar plants.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Stephens Family Texas Superstar Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Read the Herb Garden
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Follow the labels through culinary, medicinal, dye, oil, and fragrance plants, and pick one growing idea to discuss or save for later.
cards.short_summary: A named garden displaying herbs used for several human purposes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Sally Young Johnson Herb Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.entity_name: Martha and James H. Ware Citrus Garden
cards.title: Stroll the Citrus Garden
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Walk the citrus collection and use it as a brief outdoor reset; return in spring if you want to see the garden’s fragrant blooms.
cards.short_summary: A collection of citrus varieties intended to inspire home gardeners.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Martha and James H. Ware Citrus Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Take a Tree-Canopy Break
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Bring a friend to sit, study, or talk beneath the growing tree canopy, then continue along the Gardens’ walking routes when ready.
cards.short_summary: A park area with two dozen trees growing into a shared canopy.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Landmark Nurseries Tree Park is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

cards.title: Wander the Cottage Garden
cards.subtitle: Leach Teaching Gardens, Texas A&M University
cards.notes: Look closely at the informal mix of flowers, ornamentals, and edibles, then pause by the transplanted live oak before continuing your walk.
cards.short_summary: A named cottage-style garden with mixed flowers, ornamentals, and edibles.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M state that there is no cost of admission and that the public may visit; the Lou Cashion Memorial Cottage Garden is a named feature of the Leach Teaching Gardens.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours — The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The Gardens are public and open daily from dawn to dusk; leave when it gets dark.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on the Texas Avenue corridor, a principal route linking Texas A&M University with College Station destinations.

cards.title: Visitor Center: pick up local orientation
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 1207 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Stop in for maps and local guidance before heading along Texas Avenue; the center sits next to City Hall and across from Texas A&M.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for paper maps and visitor information.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station states its Visitor Center is at 1207 Texas Avenue South, next to City Hall and across the street from Texas A&M University.
cards.source_title: Visitor Center | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.

cards.title: City Hall: see the civic center of the corridor
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 1101 Texas Ave
cards.notes: Use City Hall as a recognizable waypoint on Texas Avenue, then continue north toward campus or south toward the corridor’s shops and restaurants.
cards.short_summary: College Station’s municipal headquarters anchors the campus-facing stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists City Hall at 1101 Texas Avenue in College Station.
cards.source_title: Traveling In, Around & Beyond Aggieland | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Exterior civic landmark; check City of College Station services for building-entry details.

cards.title: Texas A&M: connect into the campus walk
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — campus frontage opposite Visitor Center
cards.notes: Use the Texas Avenue frontage to transition from College Station’s main corridor into a campus walk, then choose a museum, garden, or athletic landmark.
cards.short_summary: The university is the major campus-side destination along this route.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station identifies Texas A&M University as a College Station attraction and notes campus galleries, museums, the Bonfire Memorial, gardens, tours, and Kyle Field.
cards.source_title: Attractions | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Campus access and event availability vary by building and date.

cards.title: And Sew On: personalize a small item
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 719 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Bring a tote, gift, or apparel idea and ask about the shop’s embroidery, appliqué, heat-pressing, or vinyl-lettering services before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A corridor stop centered on customized gifts and apparel.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists And Sew On at 719 Texas Avenue South and describes embroidery, appliqué, heat pressing, and vinyl lettering services.
cards.source_title: And Sew On | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Lupe Tortilla: choose a Tex-Mex meal
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 813 Texas Ave
cards.notes: Plan a meal stop around the listed fajitas, tacos, enchiladas, and fresh-made tortillas; confirm seating and current menu directly with the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Texas Avenue restaurant serving a documented Tex-Mex menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Lupe Tortilla at 813 Texas Avenue and describes its Tex-Mex menu as including fajitas, tacos, enchiladas, and fresh-made tortillas.
cards.source_title: Lupe Tortilla | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Freebirds: build a burrito or bowl
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2050 S Texas Ave
cards.notes: Use the customization menu to assemble a burrito, bowl, salad, taco, nachos, or quesadilla; check current ingredients and dietary options before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service stop with several documented buildable meal formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Freebirds at 2050 South Texas Avenue and says customers can choose burritos, nachos, salads, bowls, tacos, or quesadillas.
cards.source_title: Freebirds - Texas Ave. | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: daily 10:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.

cards.title: DSW: browse shoes by occasion
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2026 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Browse the footwear assortment for a specific need—casual, formal, athletic, or dress—then verify in-store sizes and current inventory before buying.
cards.short_summary: A Texas Avenue retail stop focused on footwear categories.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists DSW at 2026 Texas Avenue South and describes footwear for men, women, and children across casual, formal, athletic, and dress uses.
cards.source_title: DSW | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Juicing to be Gooden Fit: order juice or a wellness shot
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2414 Texas Ave S, Suite B
cards.notes: Choose from the shop’s documented juices and wellness shots for a daytime stop; confirm the current menu and ingredients at the counter before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A juice-bar stop on the south Texas Avenue stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Juicing to be Gooden Fit at 2414 Texas Avenue South, Suite B, and describes juices and wellness shots.
cards.source_title: Juicing to be Gooden Fit | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 7 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday noon–5 p.m.

cards.title: Mojo Tortilla Co.: try tortillas made on-site
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 3125 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Make this a meal stop for tortillas prepared on-site and build-your-own tacos; use the listed address to continue along the south Texas Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A south-corridor Tex-Mex stop with on-site tortilla preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Mojo Tortilla Co. at 3125 Texas Avenue South and states that it makes handcrafted tortillas fresh on-site and offers build-your-own tacos.
cards.source_title: Mojo Tortilla Co. | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: The listing reports the restaurant as open 24/7; confirm before a late visit.

cards.title: Post Oak Mall: extend the corridor to indoor shopping
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — beside Texas Ave at 1500 Harvey Rd
cards.notes: Use the mall as an indoor retail destination immediately off the Texas Avenue corridor; identify a specific store or service before you go and confirm its hours.
cards.short_summary: A named shopping center beside the Texas Avenue route.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station identifies Post Oak Mall as a College Station destination and notes that major routes including Texas Avenue connect major destinations across the city.
cards.source_title: Traveling In, Around & Beyond Aggieland | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Individual tenant hours and access vary.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Texas A&M University-College Station, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm, walkable first-weekend sequence of campus landmarks, study stops, and public spaces.

cards.title: Start with campus orientation
cards.subtitle: Rudder Tower
cards.notes: Pick up campus context first, then use the Visitor Center’s landmarks list to set a simple walking route for the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Begin with an official overview of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M’s Visitor Center identifies campus landmarks and points of interest, including the Memorial Student Center, Century Tree, and Academic Plaza.
cards.source_title: Texas A&M Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: Check the Visitor Center site before arrival for tour availability and visitor information.

cards.title: See the historic dome
cards.subtitle: Academic Plaza
cards.notes: Walk through Academic Plaza and pause at the rotunda details; the official campus guide notes both the seal mosaic and Liberty Bell replica.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus landmark with a distinctive rotunda.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academic Building was constructed in 1914 and its foyer includes a mosaic of Texas A&M’s seal and a Liberty Bell replica in the rotunda.
cards.source_title: Campus Destinations | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: Use normal building-access rules; enjoy the exterior and plaza if interior access is limited.

cards.title: Walk to the Century Tree
cards.subtitle: Near the Academic Building
cards.notes: Continue a short distance to the live oak, take a photo from the path, and leave the tree and surrounding grounds undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A named live-oak landmark beside Academic Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M identifies the Century Tree as a live oak near the Academic Building, likely planted around the turn of the 20th century.
cards.source_title: Campus Destinations | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: View from public campus paths and protect the tree’s root area.

cards.title: Browse the exhibition gallery
cards.subtitle: 400 Spence Street
cards.notes: Visit the first-floor exhibition gallery, then ask staff about current displays or arrange a tour if you want a deeper archives introduction.
cards.short_summary: An archives stop with a public exhibition gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Cushing Memorial Library & Archives states that its first-floor exhibition gallery is open to the public and lists its address at 400 Spence Street.
cards.source_title: Cushing Memorial Library & Archives
cards.access_notes: The library’s visit page lists standard Monday–Friday hours; verify holiday and schedule changes before going.

cards.title: Follow Military Walk
cards.subtitle: Central campus walkway
cards.notes: Use this quarter-mile route to connect central-campus landmarks, reading the historical markers as you go instead of treating it as a hurried shortcut.
cards.short_summary: A marked pedestrian route through campus history.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M describes Military Walk as a quarter-mile walkway through campus with historical markers and restored brick and limestone pavers.
cards.source_title: Campus Destinations | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: Stay on the walkway and observe posted campus-access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Sam Houston Sanders Corps of Cadets Center
cards.title: Explore Corps history
cards.subtitle: Corps of Cadets area
cards.notes: Visit during posted weekday hours and focus on the museum exhibits, which document Corps history and several Texas A&M traditions.
cards.short_summary: A museum-based introduction to Corps and Aggie history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sam Houston Sanders Corps of Cadets Center houses a museum with Aggie artifacts and exhibits on Texas A&M traditions and history.
cards.source_title: About Us | Texas A&M Corps of Cadets
cards.access_notes: The Corps site lists Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm access before a weekend visit.

cards.title: Visit the Bonfire Memorial thoughtfully
cards.subtitle: Memorial site on campus
cards.notes: Walk the Spirit Ring slowly, read the portals and reflections, and keep the visit quiet and respectful of the people memorialized there.
cards.short_summary: A campus memorial interpreting the 1999 Bonfire collapse.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M states that Bonfire Memorial was dedicated at the site of the 1999 Bonfire collapse and includes the Spirit Ring and 12 portals.
cards.source_title: Bonfire Memorial | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: On-site tours are offered by MSC Hospitality; request one in advance if desired.

cards.title: Make the MSC your reset stop
cards.subtitle: 275 Joe Routt Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the MSC as a central indoor break: locate services, check event postings, and plan the next stop before heading back outside.
cards.short_summary: A central campus facility with services, vendors, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Student Center hosts vendors, services, dining and entertainment, and lists its physical address at 275 Joe Routt Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Memorial Student Center | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: The page lists summer hours of 7 a.m.–8 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday; verify seasonal hours.

cards.title: Take an outdoor pause at Aggie Park
cards.subtitle: Between Alumni Center and Koldus Building
cards.notes: Choose a bench or open lawn for a low-key break, then look for the water features and performance pavilion before continuing your walk.
cards.short_summary: A 20-acre campus park with water features and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas A&M describes Aggie Park as a 20-acre outdoor space with an amphitheater, water features, an ice cream shop, and a performance pavilion.
cards.source_title: Campus Destinations | Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas and follow any event signage or temporary access restrictions.

cards.entity_name: The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.title: End with a daylight garden walk
cards.subtitle: 556 John Kimbrough Boulevard
cards.notes: Finish in daylight with a self-guided walk through the public gardens; take photos from paths and leave when it gets dark as requested.
cards.short_summary: A free public garden for a calm final stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardens at Texas A&M are free to visit, open daily from dawn to dusk, and open to campus visitors and the public.
cards.source_title: Admission & Hours | The Gardens at Texas A&M University
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; the Gardens asks visitors to leave when it gets dark.
